thread:
Ana: Heads-up — BlueOrbit + ThetaCompute want a joint showcase at EdgeAI Summit. They want a LangChain / LlamaIndex gateway adapter, a quantized model validation on Theta hardware, and a marketplace listing. Who owns what?
Mike: I'm in. Suggest two parallel tracks: adapter + demo, and quant perf/validation. Marketing sync needed for announcement timing. :calendar:
Shilpi: I can own the LangChain adapter. Timeline? Can we target an alpha in ~2 weeks?
Jordan: BlueOrbit will provide SI playbooks and a partner engineer. They need orchestration hooks (canary/fallback) so customers can adopt smoothly.
Kevin: Theta engineering confirmed int8/int4 validation. I'll own model artifacts and perf SLOs. Need sample prompt sets.
Claire: Marketing notes — joint announcement needs 2-week review, embargo date, co-branded assets, and a demo video. I'll coordinate that.
BlueOrbit_PM: We can attach an SI engineer for the POC. Also we need a marketplace SKU and clear install docs for our services.
Theta_Comm: We'll reserve an on-site hardware slot and share benchmark templates. Want a co-branded blog and short case study.
Ana: OK owners: Shilpi (adapter), Kevin (model & bench), Jordan (SI integration), Claire (comms). Mike coordinates marketplace + release. Deliverables + rough due dates below.
Shilpi: Quick checklist idea — will prototype a small shim first then a full Runner integration. Prefer shim + example notebook for faster demo.
Ana: Checklist:
```
- Adapter alpha (LangChain + LlamaIndex shim) — owner: Shilpi — target: 2 weeks
- Quantized perf report (int8/int4) — owner: Kevin — target: 2 weeks
- SI playbook + orchestration hooks — owner: Jordan — target: 2.5 weeks
- Marketplace listing draft (SKU, billing, install) — owner: Mike — target: 3 weeks
- Joint press assets (logos, boilerplate, demo video) — owner: Claire — target: 3 weeks
- Dry-run demo & recording — owner: Ana — target: 3.5 weeks
```
Mike: Sales wants a May 10 public launch. Tight but possible if we avoid blockers. I'll own the release calendar and cross-team gating.
Kevin: I'll start perf runs on Theta dev cluster today. Proposed reproducible command:
```
./run_bench.sh --model redwood/opt-13b-quant --q 4 --hw theta-a2 --seq 2048 --prompts prompts/edge-suite.json
```
Shilpi: For the adapter, question: do we ship a LangChain Runner integration or a small library shim + examples? Shim gets us to demo faster.
Jordan: For orchestration we need standard endpoints: /onboard, /canary, /fallback plus a small K8s job for canary promotion. I'll draft an API spec.
Claire: Marketing asks for assets: SVG logos, boilerplate partner quotes, 1-line launch blurb, and 3 screenshots. Legal will need to sign off on the co-branding.
Ana: One more — marketplace billing metadata (metering, entitlements). Mike can you loop finance? @Mike
Mike: @Ana yep, looping finance & partnerships ops, will chase billing schema and marketplace contract points.
deploy-bot: Reminder: nightly integration CI will run against theta/dev using branch partner/blueorbit at 03:00 UTC.
BlueOrbit_PM: We'll prepare a POC checklist for customer success and a templated onboarding email.
Ana: :thumbsup: Great. Use this thread for quick updates. If you hit blockers, ping me directly. Next sync: Friday 10am PT (standup will be 30 min).
